verdict.rationale: Docs show mise keeps multiple tool versions installed centrally and projects declare which version to use, with automatic switching between projects (mise-docs-65, mise-docs-5, mise-docs-53, mise-docs-64), implying a single shared install per version rather than per-project duplication. However, there is no explicit claim of a 'content-addressable store,' hash-based storage, or documented disk-space dedup guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit content-addressable/hash-based storage architecture description, disk-usage/dedup benchmarks, and independent confirmation that installs are never duplicated across projects.
